prompt: When a route's schema for a request part is a root primitive, Fastify validates the coerced value but the handler still receives the original one. For example, with schema.body { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 10 } and the JSON body "10" (a string), validation passes but request.body is still the string '10'. Fix validation so that a value Ajv coerces at the root of a request part is assigned to the request, for every primitive type: the example must give request.body === 10 (a number), and a body schema { type: 'boolean' } with the JSON body "true" must give request.body === true. Validation must still reject invalid values with a 400 (the JSON body "0" against the integer schema above). Routes using a custom validatorCompiler, whose validators are plain functions rather than Ajv validators, must keep working as before.
requirement: validateParam passes { parentData: request, parentDataProperty: paramName } to Ajv validators (those with schemaEnv), so root coercion of body/querystring/params/headers is written back to request[paramName] for every primitive type ('"10"' → 10 for an integer schema, '"true"' → true for a boolean schema). Out-of-range values still produce 400. Validators that are not Ajv validators (custom validatorCompiler) are called with the data as before.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: body schema { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 10 } with JSON body "10": status 200 and request.body is the number 10
body schema { type: 'boolean' } with JSON body "true": request.body is the boolean true
JSON body "0" against the integer schema is rejected with 400
a route with a custom validatorCompiler returning a plain validator function still validates and responds

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.12.0 (root-primitive coercion is lost), fixed upstream in 1ef8a60c. The reference is that fix applied to v5.12.0. The hidden suite extends the upstream test with the boolean, invalid and custom-validator cases the prompt states.
